description: Permanent pre-repair baseline of the I3.4 pinned-model executive scaffold. Captured before the I3.4.1 scientific protocol repair. Preserved as historical evidence; not modified by subsequent work.

scientific_criteria_v1.supersession_note: V1 used max(0, optimal_utility - realized_utility) as DG, which is actually TR. V2 will restore the proper IG/DG/TR decomposition. V1 is preserved as historical evidence and must not be edited.

i3_3_2_benchmark_closure.immutability: The 750 frozen tasks, task summaries, private latent environments, split allocation, action vocabulary, resource profiles, policy semantics, utility weights, topology identities, and I3.2.2 sequential-information methodology remain immutable.

known_audit_findings.description: DG was defined as max(0, optimal_utility - realized_utility) which is TR (total regret), not DG (decision gap). The proper decomposition TR = IG + DG was not implemented.

No evaluation-specific observable oracle views. The 750-task global observable value was used for all scientific subsets, but the observable optimum depends on the prior over latent states in each evaluation population.
Scientific Criteria V1 conflated DG and TR. Primary hypothesis stated DG_aware < DG_blind but the metric used was trajectory_regret = max(0, optimal - realized) which is TR.
No topology-cluster bootstrap for structural held-out inference. 150 tasks represent only 51 topologies; task-level bootstrap overcounts effective sample size.
No explicit thinking/reasoning mode configuration. Provider default reasoning budget is implicit, adding uncontrolled variance.
Decoder uses permissive JSON extraction (scans prose for brace-balanced substrings). Strict scientific path requires native JSON response mode.
Retry policy is too broad (retries all exceptions). No call-receipt audit trail for API attempts.
Model identity assumes immutable weights but provider may not expose stable revision. Need matched-hosted-model identity policy.
No full experiment identity binding. Controller identity is only one component; the experiment needs to bind all reproducibility inputs.
No counterbalanced paired call scheduler. Sequential blind-then-aware execution is vulnerable to provider drift.
No repetition/nondeterminism probe before scientific evaluation.
No adversarial packet tests or replay qualification tests in the test suite.

prohibition: This baseline artifact is frozen. Do not modify it. Subsequent I3.4.1 work proceeds on branch i3.4.1-scientific-protocol-repair.
